shortDescription: Manages site-to-site VPN customer gateway configurations on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the VPN customer gateway is related to.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: cidrs
options.description: List of guest CIDRs behind the gateway. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the VPN customer gateway is related to.

options.name: dpd
options.description: Enable Dead Peer Detection. Disabled per default by the API on creation if not set.

options.name: esp_lifetime
options.description: Lifetime in seconds of phase 2 VPN connection. Defaulted to 3600 by the API on creation if not set.

options.name: esp_policy
options.description: ESP policy in the format e.g. C(aes256-sha1;modp1536). Required if I(state=present).

options.name: force_encap
options.description: Force encapsulation for NAT traversal. Disabled per default by the API on creation if not set.

options.name: gateway
options.description: Public IP address of the gateway. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: ike_lifetime
options.description: Lifetime in seconds of phase 1 VPN connection. Defaulted to 86400 by the API on creation if not set.

options.name: ike_policy
options.description: IKE policy in the format e.g. C(aes256-sha1;modp1536). Required if I(state=present).

options.name: ipsec_psk
options.description: IPsec Preshared-Key. Cannot contain newline or double quotes. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the gateway.

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the VPN gateway is related to.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the VPN customer gateway.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
